default.description: The standard CI installation: every release's capabilities as .ci/openedx-releases.json declares them, run as the whole suite.

extended.description: The installation configured the other way round, plus seeded content and codejail, running only the cases default skips: manual AuthZ migration, a SUPPORT_URL, a multi-organization catalog, a course intro video and (where the release has the plugin) Python-graded problems.

aspects.description: The installation with Aspects (tutor-contrib-aspects: ClickHouse, Vector and Superset), learner PII and Studio's in-context metrics on, running only the analytics cases: the instructor dashboard's Reports tab, Superset access and dashboards, and in-context metrics. Its Open edX, MFE, Aspects and Superset images are this profile's own variant (build_tutor_main_images.yml).
